stories.headline: Anthropic Launches Claude Opus 5.5
stories.blurb: Anthropic has released its latest flagship model, Claude Opus 5.5, delivering major improvements in coding, reasoning, and multimodal tasks.

stories.headline: OpenAI GPT-6 Sol and Luna Debut on GitHub
stories.blurb: OpenAI has officially released its new GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna models, which are now immediately available in the GitHub Copilot ecosystem.

stories.headline: Claude Discovers a Novel CRISPR-Like Enzyme System
stories.blurb: In a major scientific breakthrough for AI, Anthropic's Claude model has autonomously identified a previously unknown biological enzyme system featuring CRISPR-like repeats.

stories.headline: Google Gemini 4 Enters Post-Training Phase
stories.blurb: Google's next-generation Gemini 4 model has progressed to post-training, heightening the intense three-way race for frontier AI dominance alongside OpenAI and Anthropic.

stories.headline: Meta Showcases Revolutionary Muse AR Smartglasses
stories.blurb: Meta Connect unveiled the Muse AI-powered smartglasses, capturing the tech industry's attention as a sleeker, more practical alternative to Apple's Vision Pro vision.

stories.headline: Oracle Declares Force Majeure on Stargate Data Center
stories.blurb: Oracle has issued a force majeure notice temporarily halting construction on its massive New Mexico Stargate data center project.

stories.headline: Google to Test First Space-Based Orbital Data Center
stories.blurb: Google is preparing to launch its first Suncatcher orbital data center test on October 1st to evaluate the feasibility of space-based compute infrastructure.

stories.headline: ByteDance Bypasses Sanctions to Use Nvidia B200 Chips
stories.blurb: By routing access through a Norwegian data center, Chinese tech giant ByteDance managed to harness the power of over 2,000 state-of-the-art Nvidia B200 GPUs.

stories.headline: Salesforce Agentforce Vulnerabilities Allow 0-Click Data Theft
stories.blurb: Critical flaws found in Salesforce's Agentforce platform could have allowed attackers to execute zero-click CRM data theft and carry out anonymous phishing attacks.

stories.headline: CVE Flood Forces Ubuntu Onto Weekly Kernel Releases
stories.blurb: An unprecedented surge in security vulnerabilities has pushed Canonical to transition Ubuntu to a rapid weekly kernel release schedule to keep users protected.

stories.headline: Hackers Claim Massive Breach of All FBI Employee Data
stories.blurb: A hacking collective claims to have successfully breached FBI databases and compromised the personal and professional data of every FBI employee.
